statements.text: Minimal phenomenal selfhood (MPS), introduced by Olaf Blanke and Metzinger in 2009, is the simplest form of self-consciousness. Its defining features are a globalized identification with the body as a whole, spatiotemporal self-location, and a weak first-person perspective, the purely geometrical origin of a perceptual model of reality.

sources.quote: Central defining features are (1) a globalized form of identification with the body as a whole
A weak 1PP is a purely geometrical feature of a perceptual or imagined model of reality
